title: Request Voice Service State Response
description: Mirrors telux::tel::VoiceServiceInfo (VoiceServiceState/VoiceServiceDenialCause/RadioTechnology enumerator names, verbatim). Read by taf_radio_GetNetRegState, whose Utility::Convert::CombineNetRegState() folds this voice registration state together with the data serving state (data.request_service_status).

denialCause.description: telux::tel::VoiceServiceDenialCause raw value; -1 (UNDEFINED) when not applicable.
